rows.en: See ya! Hope we run into each other again somewhere!
Well, it seems my time has come as well.
The memory of fighting alongside you will be a treasure for the rest of my life.
I won't forget any of you... Meeting you like this will stay engraved in my heart.
If a great evil should appear again... then let us fight together once more!
Yes, of course!
Thank you. I'm truly grateful. ...Well then, farewell!!
Looks like we're up next, you know?
Whoa, so it's finally here!! Welp, once I'm back, it's straight back to work.
Let's hope you've actually got some clients waiting.
It's almost time, you know?
Yeah, see ya! If anything comes up, look us up at the Narumi Detective Agency.
Farewell.
Looks like we can go back too.
Not that we'll get much rest once we're back, though.
We'll have to thank Veda for this victory.
No, Veda's power alone could never have achieved it. I'm grateful that we met all of you.
Too bad, but it looks like we're out of time.
We are Celestial Being... those who seek the eradication of war...
We must keep fighting... for the sake of the future...!!
Whoa, so it's finally my turn...
I'll never forget fighting alongside you guys!
Nor will I, Zero. Don't slack off on your training once you're back.
Yeah! Next time, I'll show you an even more awesome finishing move!
I wish Seven and Leo could have heard you say that.
I'm heading back ahead of you!! It was great meeting you all!!
Birth, your body...!!
Ooh, it's finally here!
OOO, you too, y'know?
You're right...
Welp, time to head home. I raked in plenty of Cell Medals, so I'm satisfied, real satisfied.
Thank you for everything, everyone.
When Ikadevil and the others misused the Medals, I wondered what would become of us,
but thanks to all of you, we were able to defeat them.
I thank you from the bottom of my heart for fighting alongside us. OOO, Birth, and Ankh.
Hmph! Well, it made for a decent way to kill time.
You're never straight with anyone, are you, Anko~
Come on, at least say a proper goodbye at the end.
It's thanks to everyone that we collected this many Medals, after all.
Tch! Suit yourselves.
Really, sorry for all the trouble!
See ya!
...Take care, everyone!!
...So it's come!!
My journey of battle goes on. The Gundam Fight... Once I'm back, my real battle begins!!
I'm proud to have fought alongside a warrior like you, whose heart burns so fiercely.
The way you broke through that wall in the Ultra Cube was magnificent.
You fought a mighty evil through to the very end. You're a splendid Fighter.
You all put up a good fight too. Next time we meet, I'd love to have a bout with you.
...!? It seems it's time for us to go back as well.
Right!
So it seems.
Kamen Riders, Gundams... Even back in our own worlds, let us give our all for the future.
Yes, of course.
Even if we should lose our power,
we'll never give up, and we'll fight on to the very end!
We believe that the bonds we forged in this world will become a great strength.
We are not alone. We have hearts of justice, joined by countless bonds.
But should a great evil ever stand before us again, let us join hands and face it together!
Understood.
It's a promise.
Then, farewell!
...Looks like I'm next.
I wish I'd fought beside you all too. Meeting so many comrades with hearts of justice in this world
has been a really precious experience. I'd better work hard too, so I don't fall behind any of you.
Battles await us back home as well. Let's give it our all together and bring down Shocker.
Where are we...?
A briefing room...? It's not the Ra Cailum or the Argama, though...
I've never been anywhere like this before.
...This room looks a lot like the Space Garrison's headquarters.
The Space Garrison?
Yeah, it's from my world... Basically, it's an organization that protects peace in the universe.
I see... But this control panel is the same as the ones I know.
So is this a place connected to our worlds...?
It's possible.
...Hey! Look at this! Seems like there are other rooms too!
...You're right! There are tons of rooms!
No sign of the enemy either... This seems to be a safe place.
Yeah! Hey, why don't we all check this place out?
I'm all for it! A place like this might have something in it.
